title: LightCarbon LCG071-PRO gravel frameset with integrated handlebar
notes: Exact page identifies LCG071-PRO and supplies Toray T700+T800 construction, four size-specific frame weights including the storage lid, 495 g fork, 700C/650B/29er clearance, T47, UDH, integrated cockpit, storage, geometry, ISO4210 and two-year warranty. No retail price is exposed.
